messages:
sam: Heads up — saw a big p95 scrape latency spike in prom-west2 right when the GPU autoscaler added ~80 nodes. remote_write queue length jumped, kvcache evictions spiked, and we saw a flurry of 504s from the write proxy. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/px123/prometheus-overview

anita: Yep, alert fired: `prom.scrape_latency_p95 > 1s` for 5m. Runbook suggests checking relabeler/backpressure and exporter cardinality.

leo: Adding context: the new nodes' node-exporters include ephemeral labels (`instance_id`, `pod_epoch`) which are blowing up series cardinality. relabeler pod CPU is pegged ~90% and queue length is increasing.

ciara: Is the relabeler regex doing a capture on the whole pod name? That can allocate a lot. Also kvcache TTL is only 5m so churn is high during mass join.

sam: Temporary mitigation idea — drop ephemeral labels at scrape time and splay exporter start times. Proposed relabel config to drop `instance_id` / `pod_epoch` below. Will canary to staging first.

```yaml
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_instance_id]
    action: drop
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_pod_epoch]
    action: drop
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_name]
    regex: (.+)-pool-.*
    target_label: node_shard
    replacement: $1
```

anita: Good. I'll apply to staging relabeler and spin relabeler replicas 2->4. Also bump scraper `max_concurrency` from 20 -> 30 to reduce per-scrape queuing.

sre-bot: deploy started: relabeler/staging replicas=4 (by anita) — CI passed.

leo: Longer term we should: (a) derive a stable `node_shard` instead of relying on ephemeral IDs; (b) increase kvcache TTL from 5m -> 15m during scale events; (c) add per-node scraper rate-limits to avoid synchronized bursts.

ciara: Agree. Also update alerting: add `prom.scrape_cardinality_delta` alert and change noisy p95 alert to p99 for low-cardinality exporters so we avoid churn noise.

sam: Action items: 1) apply relabel drop to prod canary (I will), 2) scale relabelers (anita), 3) run `promtool check` on the relabel rules (I will), 4) add kvcache eviction panel and cardinality delta panel (anita). I'll own 1 and 3.

anita: :thumbsup: I'll do 2 and 4. tagging @ops for cost/capacity awareness.

ops: Noted. scaling relabelers + extra scrape concurrency is estimated ~0.3 vCPU and some memory per replica — cost impact negligible for now. Keep us posted if this becomes persistent.

ciara: Postmortem note idea: implement exporter boot splay + jittered register backoff so we don't get mass registration during autoscale. Also consider a small grace window where we apply relaxed ttl/limits.

sam: Patch linked: https://github.com/redwood/infraprod/pull/542 — will monitor canary for 15m after prod canary deploy and report back.

anita: :eyes: Canary looks good — p95 back down to ~180ms after rules applied. remote_write queue length normalizing. Leaving prod canary open for 30m then promote.

ciara: Nice. After promote let's schedule a short runbook update and a postmortem doc with timeline and cost estimate.

sam: Thanks all — closing on this thread once promote done.
